source_note.zh: 质量分、六维能力、编码/Agent 分、速度与价格整理自 Artificial Analysis（2026-10）；blurb 为自动生成待人工润色。具体价格以站点自身定价为准。
source_note.en: Quality, six capability indexes, coding/agentic scores, speed and price from Artificial Analysis (Oct 2026); blurbs auto-generated pending review. Actual prices are set by the site.

blurb.zh: 开源可自部署视觉模型，输入$0.6/M便宜，但智力C档、速度慢，仅适合轻量图文场景。
blurb.en: Open-weights vision model, self-hostable. Cheap at $0.6/M input but C-tier smarts and slow—only for light image-text tasks.

blurb.zh: 速度快、编码尚可、百万上下文，适合日常开发；但Agent弱、首字慢、价格偏高，复杂任务别指望。
blurb.en: Fast with solid coding and 1M context—good for daily dev; weak agent skills, slow first token, premium price.

blurb.zh: 小米开源可自部署，百万上下文加60分编码是亮点；但智力C档、Agent弱、速度慢，仅适合预算紧的长文档与轻编码。
blurb.en: Open-weights, self-hostable, 1M context, 60-pt coding at $0.05/task—but C-tier smarts, weak agents, slow. Skip for hard tasks.

blurb.zh: 轻量闭源，智力仅18.7，难题别用；256K长上下文适合长文档摘要等基础任务。
blurb.en: Lightweight closed model, AA index 18.7—avoid hard tasks; 256K context fits basic long-doc summarization.

blurb.zh: OpenAI 低价位档，速度尚可、上下文超长，适合日常多模态与长文档处理；智力平平，别指望它啃硬骨头。
blurb.en: OpenAI's budget tier with long context and vision; fine for everyday tasks, but don't expect it to crack hard problems.

blurb.zh: 极速低价（$0.04/任务）轻量模型，适合高并发简单任务；Agent能力弱，不宜复杂推理编码。
blurb.en: Blazing-fast, ultra-cheap ($0.04/task) for high-volume simple tasks; weak agent skills, avoid complex reasoning/coding.

blurb.zh: Qwen3.5 全模态 Plus：音频/图像输入，适合中文多模态轻应用；智力有限别指望推理。
blurb.en: Omni-modal Qwen (audio/image in) for light Chinese multimodal apps; limited reasoning.

blurb.zh: Amazon闭源多模态模型，支持图文与百万级上下文，适合长文档图片；智力13.6，弱于复杂推理。
blurb.en: Amazon's closed multimodal model for long docs and images, but intelligence index 13.6 limits complex reasoning.

blurb.zh: OpenAI编程模型，400K上下文+视觉，智力28.5、延迟80秒，仅适合非实时代码处理。
blurb.en: OpenAI coding model, 400K context & vision, but 28.5 IQ score & 80s latency—patient code work only.

blurb.zh: 适合长上下文、图文输入且可自部署的轻量场景；速度快、价格低，但智力档C，不擅长难题。
blurb.en: Open-weights, 262k context, vision input; fast, cheap, self-hosted lightweight multimodal tasks, not for hard reasoning.

blurb.zh: 开源多模态12B小模型，超长上下文、价格极低；智力仅C档，适合轻量自部署，不擅长难题。
blurb.en: Open-weights 12B multimodal, long context, rock-bottom price; C-tier smarts—fine for light self-hosted apps, not hard problems.

blurb.zh: Google 轻量多模态模型，支持文本、图像、音频、视频，上下文 100 万 token；速度 192 tok/s，但智力指数仅 23.8，适合日常任务，难胜任复杂推理。
blurb.en: Google's lightweight multimodal model with 1M token context; fast at 192 tok/s but limited intelligence (23.8), best for routine tasks, not complex reasoning.

blurb.zh: 适合需要视觉理解但预算有限的轻量任务，200K上下文是亮点；别指望它处理复杂推理或高难度编码。
blurb.en: For lightweight vision tasks on a budget with 200K context; don't expect complex reasoning or advanced coding.

blurb.zh: 适合简单问答，极便宜；编码弱、4K上下文，复杂任务别用。
blurb.en: Cheap for simple Q&A; weak coding, 4K context. Avoid complex tasks.

blurb.zh: Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking 适合超长上下文和多模态的实验场景；能力有限，勿用于复杂任务。
blurb.en: Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking suits experimental long-context and multimodal use; limited, not for complex tasks.

blurb.zh: Anthropic 中端主力：A 级质量、1M 上下文、支持视觉，适合长文档与多模态办公；闭源，成本中等。
blurb.en: Anthropic's mid-tier: A-grade, 1M context, vision—ideal for long-doc/multimodal work; closed-source, moderate cost.

blurb.zh: 开源可自部署代码模型，131K长上下文；智力C档，适合日常补全，难任务别指望。
blurb.en: Self-hostable open coding model with 131K context; C-tier smarts, best for routine tasks.

blurb.zh: Perplexity搜索推理模型，127K上下文适合联网问答与资料整合；智力指数8.7偏低，不适合复杂推理。
blurb.en: Perplexity's search-reasoning model, 127K context, good for web Q&A and research; 8.7 intelligence score, skip for hard reasoning.

blurb.zh: Gemma 3 270M 是极小开源模型，智力分仅 5.1，适合端侧或轻量本地部署，难当难题。
blurb.en: Gemma 3 270M is a tiny open-weights model with a 5.1 intelligence score, suited to on-device or lightweight local deployment—not hard problems.

blurb.zh: Grok 4.20 0309 有 200 万上下文和视觉，智力仅 25.2；适合海量文档，不适合复杂推理。
blurb.en: Grok 4.20 0309: 2M context + vision, but 25.2 intelligence; for long docs, not complex reasoning.

blurb.zh: 编程向模型，400K超长上下文适合大代码库分析；智力分23.7、延迟14秒，不适合高难度推理或实时交互。
blurb.en: Coding-focused with 400K context for large codebases; 23.7 intelligence score and 14s latency make it unsuitable for hard reasoning or real-time chat.

blurb.zh: 适合需百万级上下文、多模态和快速编码的团队；首字延迟14秒偏高，Agent能力一般，复杂推理欠佳。
blurb.en: For teams needing 1M context, multimodal input, and fast coding; 14s first-token latency is high, agent skills mediocre, not for complex reasoning.

blurb.zh: OpenAI低价轻量款：百万上下文+视觉，$0.01/任务、速度快；智力21、Agent弱，宜简单问答与文档，不擅长难题。
blurb.en: OpenAI budget lite: 1M context + vision, $0.01/task, fast; intelligence 21, weak agents—good for simple QA/docs, not hard tasks.

blurb.zh: 编码扎实、百万上下文，适合专业团队处理长文档；但速度慢、每任务$2.37偏高，闲聊别用。
blurb.en: Strong coding, 1M context suits pro teams on long docs; but slow and $2.37/task—overkill for casual chat.

blurb.zh: Mistral Medium 3.1：轻量闭源，支持图文与128K上下文；适合日常图文任务，复杂编码与Agent别用。
blurb.en: Mistral Medium 3.1: lightweight closed-source, vision+128K context; good for daily text/image tasks, weak at coding/agents.

blurb.zh: GPT-5 nano 是 OpenAI 轻量款，智力 C 档但快且便宜（$0.05/M），支持图文与 40 万上下文；适合高并发简单任务，难题别用。
blurb.en: OpenAI's lightweight model: C-tier smarts, fast and cheap ($0.05/M input), with vision and 400K context. Best for high-volume simple tasks, not hard problems.

blurb.zh: 适合超长文本或音视频输入；百万级上下文是亮点，但能力分低，难啃硬题。
blurb.en: For million-token context or audio/video input; long context shines, but low capability—skip for hard problems.

blurb.zh: 速度快、覆盖广但智力档偏低，适合轻量问答与写作，不适合难题和Agent任务。
blurb.en: Fast, broad coverage, but low intelligence tier. Good for light Q&A and drafting, not hard problems or agent tasks.

blurb.zh: 早期推理模型，智力C档、编码34；$66/M输出极贵，仅适合需128K上下文且预算充足者。
blurb.en: Early reasoning model, C-tier intelligence, 34 coding; $66/M output is pricey, only for 128K context needs with budget.

blurb.zh: 价格极低的开源模型，适合预算敏感、可自部署的轻量场景；智力分13.9，难处理复杂推理。
blurb.en: Ultra-cheap open-weights model for budget, self-hosted lightweight tasks; 13.9 intelligence score limits complex reasoning.

blurb.zh: 编码尚可但推理弱，适合预算紧的轻量编码与长文本/图片处理，每任务$0.46是卖点。
blurb.en: Decent coding, weak reasoning; fits budget light coding with long-context/image input at $0.46/task.

blurb.zh: 编码尚可、Agent 弱的 B 档模型，胜在百万上下文和 $0.26 低成本；适合预算紧的长文档与视觉任务。
blurb.en: B-tier: decent coding, weak agents; 1M context at $0.26/task suits budget long-doc and vision work.

blurb.zh: 顶级质量+百万上下文，适合深度推理；首字延迟161秒，不适合实时对话；$0.39/任务属旗舰便宜档。
blurb.en: S-tier quality, 1M context for deep reasoning; 161s first-token latency kills real-time use; $0.39/task is cheap for a flagship.

blurb.zh: 阿里开源编程MoE，256K长上下文、便宜可自部署；智力C档，适合日常代码补全，难啃复杂题。
blurb.en: Alibaba's open coding MoE: 256K context, cheap, self-hostable; tier C—routine coding only.

blurb.zh: 447 tok/s 的极致速度 + $0.19/任务，海量轻量请求（打标/摘要/路由）首选。
blurb.en: Extreme speed (447 tok/s) at $0.19/task — the pick for high-volume lightweight calls (tagging, summaries, routing).

blurb.zh: 阶跃星辰 Step 5 预览：A 档下沿、价格友好，中文生态新势力，预览期留意稳定性。
blurb.en: StepFun Step 5 preview: lower A-tier at friendly pricing; a rising Chinese-ecosystem player — watch stability during preview.

blurb.zh: 适合预算有限、需本地部署长文档/多模态的开发者；智力编码弱，难处理复杂逻辑。
blurb.en: For budget-limited devs needing local long-context/multimodal deployment; weak reasoning and coding, not for complex tasks.

blurb.zh: 开源可自部署轻量编码模型，256K 上下文是亮点；智能指数 8.6、Agent 弱，仅适合本地简单代码补全。
blurb.en: Open-weight self-hostable coding model; 256K context shines, but 8.6 intelligence and weak agents limit it to simple local coding.

blurb.zh: 老款入门模型，200K 上下文、支持图片输入；智力分 7.9 偏低、编码一般，闭源且价格不低，难胜任复杂任务。
blurb.en: Legacy entry-level model, 200K context, image input; 7.9 intelligence is low, closed-source and not cheap—avoid complex tasks.

blurb.zh: 开源可自部署的 DeepSeek 推理模型，智力仅 14.8、Agent 弱，适合轻量推理编码，难啃硬题。
blurb.en: Self-hostable open DeepSeek reasoner, but weak agent skills and modest intelligence (14.8) — fine for light coding, not hard problems.

blurb.zh: 开源全模态模型，支持文本/图像/音频/视频，价格极低；智力C档，适合多模态应用，难推理别用。
blurb.en: Open-weights omni model (text/image/audio/video) at budget price; C-tier intelligence, good for multimodal apps, not hard reasoning.

blurb.zh: 适合预算有限的轻量编码，支持长上下文和图像输入；智力偏低，避难题。价低速度尚可。
blurb.en: Budget-friendly for light coding with long context and vision; low intelligence, avoid hard tasks. Cheap, decent speed.

blurb.zh: IBM开源3B小模型，自部署成本极低，适合本地轻量任务与隐私场景；推理与Agent能力弱，不宜处理复杂代码。
blurb.en: IBM's open 3B model: dirt-cheap self-hosting for lightweight local tasks and privacy, but weak reasoning/agents—skip for complex coding.

blurb.zh: Amazon 中档多模态模型：256K 长上下文加视觉输入，但智力偏低、首字延迟 15 秒，仅适合长文档看图类轻任务。
blurb.en: Amazon mid-tier multimodal model: 256K context + vision, but low intelligence and 15s first-token latency—light long-doc tasks only.

blurb.zh: Thinking Machines（Mira Murati 团队）新玩家：220 tok/s + 1M 上下文，早期阶段值得观察。
blurb.en: New player from Thinking Machines (Mira Murati's team): 220 tok/s with 1M context; early days, worth watching.

blurb.zh: 开源多模态长文本模型，编码尚可但智力仅27，适合预算有限的轻量任务，难胜任复杂问题。
blurb.en: Open multimodal long-context model; decent coding but low intelligence (27)—for budget light tasks, not hard problems.

blurb.zh: 开源可自部署推理模型，176 tok/s、$0.26/任务，适合预算有限的日常问答；智力与Agent分低，不适合难题。
blurb.en: Open-weights reasoning model: fast (176 tok/s), cheap ($0.26/task), good for budget Q&A; low intelligence/agent scores—avoid hard problems.

blurb.zh: DeepSeek R1 Distill Llama 8B 适合本地轻量推理实验；智力指数仅 6.5，难处理复杂问题。
blurb.en: DeepSeek R1 Distill Llama 8B suits local lightweight reasoning; intelligence 6.5, not for hard problems.

blurb.zh: Qwen3 0.6B：轻量开源、可自部署、32K 上下文，但智力指数仅 4.8，仅适合简单分类等任务。
blurb.en: Qwen3 0.6B: lightweight, open, self-deployable, 32K context, but intelligence score only 4.8—suited only for simple tasks like classification.

blurb.zh: 阿里开源多模态长文本模型，$0.47/任务；但智力C档、Agent弱、速度慢，仅适合轻量任务。
blurb.en: Alibaba's open multimodal model at $0.47/task; but C-tier intelligence, weak agents, slow—light tasks only.

blurb.zh: LFM2 1.2B：1.2B 参数、智力指数 4.8，适合边端轻任务，可自部署，别指望做难题。
blurb.en: LFM2 1.2B: 1.2B params, AA index 4.8, for edge light tasks, self-deployable, not for hard problems.

blurb.zh: 适合预算有限、需多模态与长上下文的开发者；可自部署，智力指数23.6，难胜任复杂推理。
blurb.en: Budget pick for multimodal and long-context needs; open-weights, but 23.6 intelligence limits complex reasoning.

blurb.zh: Mistral 开源轻量款，可自部署跑简单任务；智力分偏低，难题别用。
blurb.en: Mistral's open-weight light model for simple local tasks; low intelligence, avoid hard problems.

blurb.zh: IBM 开源轻量模型，可自部署、成本极低，适合预算敏感常规业务；智力与 Agent 弱，不擅长难题。
blurb.en: IBM's open-weights, self-deployable budget model for routine work; weak reasoning and agents—skip hard problems.

blurb.zh: 开源可自部署的7B模型，52万超长上下文；智力与Agent偏弱，仅适合轻量长文档。
blurb.en: Open 7B, self-hostable, 524K context; weak intelligence and agent scores—only for light long-doc tasks.

blurb.zh: $0.06/任务的 B 档款，轻量中文任务几乎白送，海量调用场景闭眼选。
blurb.en: B-tier at $0.06/task — nearly free for light Chinese tasks; a no-brainer for bulk calls.

blurb.zh: LFM 40B 有视觉但智力仅5.4，适合轻量图文理解，别指望它做难题。
blurb.en: LFM 40B offers vision input but only 5.4 intelligence; fine for light image-text tasks, don't expect hard reasoning.

blurb.zh: MiniMax-M2.5 开源轻量可自部署，智力仅 22.8，仅适合预算有限的简单任务。
blurb.en: MiniMax-M2.5: open-weights, self-deployable, cheap ($0.3/M in); fine for simple tasks, but low intelligence (22.8)—no hard problems.

blurb.zh: 开源可自部署，支持图文与256K上下文，176 tok/s、价极低；智力仅9，适合轻量日常任务。
blurb.en: Open-weights, self-deployable, vision + 256K context; 176 tok/s, dirt-cheap; intelligence 9—light daily tasks only.

blurb.zh: 编码77分、百万token上下文，适合复杂代码库；但首字延迟28秒、单任务5美元，别跑日常问答。
blurb.en: 77 coding, 1M context for complex codebases; but 28s latency and $5/task—not for daily chat.

blurb.zh: 支持推理、视觉与200K上下文，适合日常问答与文档分析；但质量C级、编码弱，不适合复杂推理。
blurb.en: Reasoning, vision, and 200K context for daily Q&A and docs; but quality tier C and weak coding—avoid complex tasks.

blurb.en: Low-effort Sonnet 5: 24 IQ, not for hard tasks; 1M context + vision, good for daily docs and light multimodal.

blurb.zh: 小米开源轻量模型，256K长上下文适合自建文档处理，智力偏低，不宜攻坚。
blurb.en: Xiaomi's open 256K-context lightweight model for self-hosted docs; low intelligence, not for hard tasks.

blurb.zh: GLM-5-Turbo 智力指数仅 26.6，适合简单问答，别做复杂推理。
blurb.en: GLM-5-Turbo scores just 26.6; fine for simple Q&A, not hard reasoning.

blurb.zh: Ling-1T开源可自部署，智力指数9.2属C档，适合预算有限、需私有化且任务简单场景，别指望复杂推理。

blurb.en: Open-weights, self-deployable, fast and cheap; C-tier intelligence, fine for simple tasks, not for hard problems.

blurb.zh: 开源可自部署轻量模型，支持图文与262K上下文；智力偏低，适合预算有限的日常多模态任务。

blurb.en: NVIDIA's open 49B reasoning model: 128K context, self-hostable, but low intelligence score—light tasks only.

blurb.en: DBRX Instruct: open, self-hostable, 32K context; 5.3 intelligence, suits private basic tasks.

blurb.zh: 适合本地部署的轻量开源模型，32K上下文够用；但能力有限，别指望它处理复杂任务。
blurb.en: Lightweight open-weights model for local deployment with 32K context; limited capability, avoid complex tasks.

blurb.zh: Amazon 长文本模型，百万上下文适合整本书/日志分析；智力仅 9.2，复杂推理别指望。
blurb.en: Amazon long-context model, 1M window for books/logs; 9.2 intelligence, weak reasoning.

blurb.zh: Mistral Small 3 开源可自部署，输入 $0.05/M，智力 6.7 偏慢，适合预算敏感的简单任务。
blurb.en: Mistral Small 3: open, self-deployable, $0.05/M input, 6.7 IQ, slow—best for budget simple tasks.

blurb.zh: 适合需要图文输入和超长文档处理的日常任务用户；速度偏慢，但每任务$0.13的成本在OpenAI系列里算便宜。
blurb.en: For everyday tasks needing vision and long-context input; slow at 43 tok/s, but $0.13 per task is cheap for OpenAI.

blurb.zh: 开源可自部署，百万上下文，速度快但智力低，适合长文档与简单任务。
blurb.en: Open-weights, self-hostable, 1M context, fast but low quality; for long docs and simple tasks only.

blurb.zh: o1-pro 智力 12.4 但定价 $150/$600，性价比极低，非特殊需求不推荐。
blurb.en: o1-pro: 12.4 intelligence at $150/$600 per M tokens—poor value, avoid unless necessary.

blurb.zh: Jamba 1.6 Mini 开源可自部署，25 万 token 上下文适合长文档任务，但智力仅 C 档。
blurb.en: Jamba 1.6 Mini is open, self-deployable; 256K context suits long docs, but C-tier intelligence.

blurb.zh: OpenAI 中档闭源，百万上下文、支持图片输入，编码 76.7 但首字约 4.7 秒，宜长文档图文任务，不宜实时 Agent。
blurb.en: OpenAI mid-tier closed model: 1M context, image input, coding 76.7 but 4.7s TTFT—long docs and vision, not real-time agents.

blurb.zh: 速度快、能看图，但智力仅C档、编码弱，适合日常问答读图，慎用于难题，注意按量成本。
blurb.en: Fast, vision-capable daily driver, but C-tier reasoning and weak coding—fine for chat/images, not hard problems; watch per-token cost.

blurb.zh: S级全能选手，支持多模态输入及百万token长上下文，适合企业级复杂任务；闭源部署。
blurb.en: S-tier all-rounder with multimodal input and 1M context; ideal for enterprise tasks, though closed-source.

blurb.zh: 顶级编程模型，编码73.6分，百万上下文，适合复杂代码；但首字延迟23秒，输出$25/M，仅推荐预算充足用户。
blurb.en: Top coding model: 73.6 score, 1M context, great for complex code; but 23s latency, $25/M output—for heavy users only.

blurb.zh: 可自部署开源推理模型，128k 上下文，质量档 C，适合私有化部署及一般任务。
blurb.en: Self-hostable open-weights reasoning model, 128k context, tier C quality—fine for private deployment and routine tasks.

blurb.zh: 旗舰全能但延迟23秒、价高，仅适合企业复杂任务，勿用于实时聊天。
blurb.en: Flagship all-rounder with 23s latency & premium cost; enterprise tasks only, not real-time chat.

blurb.zh: GPT-5是OpenAI闭源旗舰，支持图像输入和128K上下文，适合日常问答；但智力指数10.4，复杂推理别指望。
blurb.en: OpenAI's closed flagship with vision, 128K context, good for daily chat; but 10.4 intelligence index—no hard reasoning.

blurb.zh: Google全能中端：百万上下文全模态输入，编码尚可，适合长文档，不擅长难题。
blurb.en: Google's mid-tier all-rounder: 1M context, multimodal input, decent coding; for long docs, not hard reasoning.

blurb.zh: 蚂蚁 Ring 2.6 1T 开源权重，自托管大杯选择，智力轻量级。
blurb.en: Open-weights 1T from InclusionAI; a large self-host option with light intelligence.

blurb.zh: Upstage轻量推理模型，智力指数仅7.5，仅适合简单任务与预算敏感场景，别指望复杂推理。
blurb.en: Upstage's lightweight reasoning model scores just 7.5; fine for simple tasks, not for hard problems.

blurb.zh: Meta 中端多模态模型，支持文/图/音输入与 26 万上下文；适合日常任务，不宜攻坚难题。
blurb.en: Meta's mid-tier multimodal model: text/image/audio in, 262k context. Good for daily tasks, weak at hard reasoning.

blurb.zh: Grok 3 Reasoning Beta 主打百万长上下文，智力仅10.4属C档，适合超长文档处理，不宜解难题。
blurb.en: Grok 3 Reasoning Beta: 1M-token context but only 10.4 intelligence (C-tier); for long docs, not hard reasoning.

blurb.zh: OpenChat 3.5 智力分 5.3，轻量可自部署，适合预算有限的基础对话，别指望难题。
blurb.en: OpenChat 3.5 scores 5.3, lightweight self-deployable for budget basic chat, not hard reasoning.

blurb.zh: Qwen3 14B 非推理版：开源可自部署、极廉价、速度尚可，但智力仅 C 档，只适合轻聊与简单任务，不擅长难题。
blurb.en: Qwen3 14B non-reasoning: open-weights, self-hostable, very cheap, decent speed—but C-tier smarts; light chat only, not hard problems.

blurb.zh: 微软开源小模型，可自部署、极便宜；智力仅5.9且慢，只适合轻量任务。
blurb.en: Microsoft's open small model: self-deployable, dirt cheap, but 5.9 intelligence and slow—light tasks only.

blurb.zh: Qwen3.5 35B A3B：预算有限、需图文与长文本、可自部署者适用；速度快，但推理编码弱，避难题。
blurb.en: Qwen3.5 35B A3B: budget pick for vision, long context, self-hosting; fast, but weak reasoning/coding—skip hard tasks.

blurb.zh: 百万token长上下文加视觉，能力全但智力平平；适合长文档和多模态日常任务，难攻难题。
blurb.en: 1M-token context plus vision, well-rounded but middling intelligence; suited for long documents and everyday multimodal tasks, not hard reasoning.

blurb.zh: OpenAI 开源权重 120B：可自托管、免费跑，智力属轻量级，胜在数据不出门。
blurb.en: Open-weights 120B from OpenAI: self-hostable and free to run. Light intelligence, but data stays in-house.

blurb.zh: 适合预算有限但要长上下文和图文的开发者：216 tok/s、百万上下文、可自部署，单任务 $0.26；A 档智力，别啃最硬的题。
blurb.en: Budget pick for 1M context + vision: 216 tok/s, open weights, $0.26/task; A-tier smarts, skip hardest problems.

blurb.zh: GLM-5 非推理版适合日常问答与写作，速度快可自部署；质量档 C，难胜任复杂任务。
blurb.en: GLM-5 non-reasoning suits daily Q&A and writing; fast, self-hostable, tier C quality—not for hard tasks.

blurb.zh: 开源可自部署9B小模型，172 tok/s够快、价极低，适合轻量推理与边缘部署；智力C档，难啃硬题。
blurb.en: Open-weight 9B, self-hostable: 172 tok/s, dirt cheap, good for light reasoning; C-tier smarts, not for hard problems.

blurb.zh: 百万级上下文+视觉，适合长文档与图片分析；但智力23.3、速度慢，复杂推理不适用，价偏高。
blurb.en: 1M context + vision for long docs/images; 23.3 IQ and slow—skip for hard reasoning; pricey.

blurb.zh: Claude 4.1 Opus 非推理版：18.6分属C档，$75/M输出贵；适合需图文理解但不为推理付费的用户。
blurb.en: Claude 4.1 Opus non-reasoning: C-tier at $75/M output; for vision without reasoning costs.

blurb.zh: S 级智力+百万上下文+视觉，擅长复杂推理与长文档；首字延迟 34 秒、单任务 $1.82，忌高频轻任务。
blurb.en: S-tier reasoning with 1M context and vision; 34s first token and $1.82/task—avoid high-frequency light work.

blurb.zh: 开源可自部署，速度快、价格低，适合轻量任务和成本敏感场景；智力一般，别指望它做难题。
blurb.en: Open weights, fast and cheap; good for light tasks and cost-sensitive use, but not for hard reasoning.

blurb.zh: 百万上下文+多模态是卖点，但智力27、速度慢；只适合低价长文档或视频摘要等轻量场景。
blurb.en: 1M context + multimodal at low price, but weak intelligence (27) and slow; for long-doc/video summary, not hard tasks.

blurb.zh: 百万上下文、图文输入、速度快、价格极低，长文档与代码性价比之选；智力B档，难任务慎选。
blurb.en: 1M context, vision, fast, ultra-cheap—great value for long docs and code; B-tier smarts, not for hard reasoning.

blurb.zh: Amazon 长上下文视觉模型：256K+图片输入；智力 12.8、编码 25.9 偏弱，只适合文档图像理解。
blurb.en: Amazon's long-context vision model: 256K + image input, but weak intelligence (12.8) and coding (25.9). Suited for document/image understanding only.

blurb.zh: 超便宜多模态轻量模型，429 tok/s 快但智力仅 C 档，适合海量简单任务，别做难题。
blurb.en: Ultra-cheap multimodal lightweight model; 429 tok/s fast but C-tier smarts—for bulk simple tasks, not hard problems.

blurb.zh: 4B开源多模态模型，256K长上下文是亮点；智力一般，适合自部署轻量图文任务，不擅长难题。
blurb.en: 4B open-weight vision model; standout 256K context, modest smarts—good for self-hosted light image-text tasks, not hard reasoning.

blurb.zh: 开源可自部署、256K长上下文、速度快，但智力与Agent能力偏弱；适合预算有限的文档处理和基础编码，不适合复杂推理或Agent任务。
blurb.en: Open-weights, self-deployable, 256K context, fast; weak reasoning and agent skills. Good for budget document processing and basic coding, not complex reasoning.

blurb.zh: 多模态长上下文入门款，编码够用但Agent与推理弱，适合轻量开发、文档图像处理。
blurb.en: Entry-level multimodal long-context; coding OK, agent/reasoning weak. Good for light dev and doc/image.

blurb.zh: 开源405B可自部署，128K上下文；智力档C，复杂推理别用，适合本地化中等任务。
blurb.en: Open-weights 405B, self-hostable, 128K context; tier C—skip hard reasoning, OK for local mid-tier tasks.

blurb.zh: 开源可自部署，204K 上下文，低价高速；智力偏低，仅适合轻量任务。
blurb.en: Open-weights, self-deployable, 204K context, cheap and fast; low intelligence, light tasks only.

blurb.zh: AI21的3B开源小模型，智力低，但26万上下文可自部署，适合本地长文档粗处理。
blurb.en: AI21's 3B open model: weak reasoning, but 262k context and self-deployable for local long-doc skimming.

blurb.zh: 开源可自部署、百万上下文、编码68.8分，适合预算有限的长文本开发者；Agent和推理偏弱。
blurb.en: Open-weights, 1M context, 68.8 coding—budget pick for long-doc devs; weak agents and reasoning.

blurb.zh: 月之暗面 Kimi K3：1.05M 超长上下文 + A 档智力，长文档/长对话是招牌；输出 42 tok/s 偏慢，急性子绕行。
blurb.en: Moonshot Kimi K3: 1.05M context and A-tier intelligence — the long-doc/long-conversation specialist; slow output (42 tok/s).

blurb.zh: OLMo 2 7B 是 AI2 开源权重模型，可自部署，适合轻量应用与研究；C 档质量、4K 上下文，难胜任复杂任务。
blurb.en: OLMo 2 7B by AI2: open-weights, self-deployable, for lightweight apps and research; C-tier quality, 4K context—not for complex tasks.

blurb.zh: 开源可自部署轻量视觉模型，256K上下文是亮点；智力C档，适合预算有限的图文场景。
blurb.en: Open-weights 4B vision model with 256K context; tier C, best for budget image-text tasks.

blurb.zh: 适合百万级长上下文与编码，速度快；但智力指数26.7偏低，不适合复杂推理或Agent任务。
blurb.en: Good for coding and million-token context with fast speed, but a 26.7 intelligence score limits complex reasoning or agent tasks.

blurb.zh: 闭源长上下文模型，256K窗口适合长文档；智力18.6偏低，不宜复杂推理。
blurb.en: Closed-source model; 256K context suits long docs, but low intelligence (18.6) makes it unfit for complex reasoning.

blurb.zh: 开源可自部署、快且便宜，适合日常问答与批量处理；智力档偏低，别做难题。
blurb.en: Open-weights, self-deployable, fast and cheap; good for daily chat and batch tasks, but low intelligence tier—skip hard problems.

blurb.zh: LFM2 24B A2B 开源可自部署，智力指数 5.9 属 C 档，仅适合预算有限的最简单任务（分类、抽取、模板化问答）。
blurb.en: LFM2 24B A2B: open weights, self-hostable; 5.9 intelligence (tier C) means only the simplest budget tasks.

blurb.zh: Amazon Nova 2.0 Lite：百万上下文+视觉，低价但智力弱、首字延迟15秒，仅适合低成本长文档批处理。
blurb.en: Amazon Nova 2.0 Lite: 1M context+vision, cheap but weak IQ, 15s first-token lag; only for budget long-doc batch jobs.

blurb.zh: 快手KwaiKAT闭源模型，256K上下文适合大型代码库，但智力指数21.7偏低，难解复杂算法。
blurb.en: KwaiKAT closed-source model: 256K context for large codebases, but low intelligence (21.7), avoid complex algorithms.

blurb.zh: 开源可自部署轻量编码模型，$0.47/任务、256K上下文，适合预算有限的常规开发；C档智力、Agent弱，难胜任复杂推理。
blurb.en: Open-weights, self-hostable coder: $0.47/task, 256K context—good for budget dev; C-tier smarts, weak agent, skip for hard reasoning.

blurb.zh: 适合需视觉输入和 400K 长上下文、任务简单的开发者；智力 20.4 偏轻量，价格便宜但首字约 17 秒，不适合交互式编码。
blurb.en: For devs needing vision and 400K context on simple tasks; 20.4 intelligence, cheap but ~17s first token—not for interactive coding.

blurb.zh: 免费多模态，支持百万上下文，适合尝鲜；智力仅8.2，难任务别用。
blurb.en: Free multimodal, 1M context, good for testing; low IQ (8.2), avoid hard tasks.

blurb.zh: Llama 65B 旧款开源模型，智力5、上下文2048，可自部署，仅适合低成本离线实验。
blurb.en: Llama 65B: old open model, IQ 5, 2048 context, self-deployable; only for cheap offline tests.

blurb.zh: 百万上下文+视觉+低价，但智力弱、首字超5秒；只配长文档粗读，别碰难题。
blurb.en: 1M context + vision, cheap, but weak IQ and 5s+ first token; light long-doc reading only, no hard tasks.

blurb.zh: 开源可自部署的百万上下文轻量模型：速度快、每任务$0.17，适合预算有限的编码与日常Agent；智力34.3偏低，不擅长难题。
blurb.en: Open-weights, 1M-context lightweight: fast, $0.17/task, fits budget coding and everyday agents; 34.3 intelligence, not for hard problems.

blurb.zh: 谷歌开源轻量多模态模型，可自部署，26万上下文，价极低；但智力编码弱，别碰难题。
blurb.en: Google's open, self-deployable multimodal model, 262k context, ultra-cheap; weak reasoning/coding, avoid hard tasks.

blurb.zh: Meta 旗舰多模态：S 档质量 + 百万上下文，适合复杂推理与音视频；首字延迟 34 秒、成本高，不宜实时交互。
blurb.en: Meta flagship multimodal: S-tier quality, 1M context for heavy reasoning and AV; 34s first token and high cost rule out chat.

blurb.zh: 编码强、六维全能的旗舰模型，适合复杂编程与专业分析；但慢且 $2.19/任务偏贵，轻活勿用。
blurb.en: Flagship coder (74.3), all-around pro—great for complex dev/analysis, but slow and $2.19/task; overkill for light use.

blurb.zh: 百万上下文、极低价轻量推理模型，适合预算有限的长文档；智力偏低，不宜难题。
blurb.en: Ultra-cheap 1M-context reasoning model for budget long docs; low intelligence, avoid hard tasks.

blurb.zh: Llama 2 Chat 7B 是 Meta 开源旧款，可自部署、价低，但智力仅 5.7，只适合轻聊测试。
blurb.en: Meta's open Llama 2 Chat 7B is cheap and self-hostable, but scores 5.7—light chat and testing only.
